label: Basic Pitch contour analysis
summary: Optional lightweight pitch and pitch-bend extraction for single instruments, vocals, or exploratory animal-call studies.

handoffs.label: Extract a pitch contour
handoffs.intent: Turn one source into an editable hypothesis for melody, guitar, or animal-response arrangement.
inputs: One isolated or mostly isolated source recording
Key, target instrument, and quantization/retuning policy
outputs: MIDI with pitch bends and an analysis note
steps: Analyze one source at a time
Use as a guide for a new response rather than a replacement performance
verification: Record confidence, timing policy, source checksum, and any manual edits

preserve: Source audio, extracted MIDI, pitch bends, and manual corrections
avoid: Assuming polyphonic extraction is clean, overwriting source audio, or skipping listening review
